pull_request.title: docs: update outdated README links and align lint list with docs (#190)
pull_request.body:
## Summary

Closes #190

The README **Features** section listed only the original three lints and linked exclusively to those doc pages, even though `docs/lints/` already documents five shipped lints and `soroban_cost_lints/src/lib.rs` registers them all. Two lint doc pages (`bytes_append_in_loop.md`, `symbol_new_for_short_literal.md`) had no inbound link from the README, and the hardcoded "Three lints ship in v0.1.1" line contradicted the current state of `main`.

This PR realigns the README with the public lint reference, without incorrectly telling users who install v0.1.1 that they will get five lints.

### Changes

- **`README.md` — Features section**
  - Replace the hardcoded "Three lints ship in `v0.1.1`" with an explicit release-status intro: **three lints ship in the released `v0.1.1`**, two more are documented on `main` and remain `Unreleased`.
  - List **all five** lints that have docs in `docs/lints/`, each linking to its doc page. Each bullet is annotated with `*(shipped in `v0.1.1`)*` or `*(Unreleased — currently on `main`)*` so the version expectation is unambiguous.
  - No other link-changes were needed: the previous link audit confirmed that every external URL (`tollcraft.gitbook.io`, GitHub org/repo/discord/telegram/contrib.rocks/Trail of Bits) resolves, and the local anchors `#editor--ide-integration` and `#github-actions` in `docs/integration.md` match the existing headings.

- **`CHANGELOG.md` — Unreleased > Added**
  - Add a missing entry for `bytes_append_in_loop`, which had previously been credited only in the source registry (`LINT_METADATA`) and the dedicated doc page, not the changelog. This was blocking the PR per the guidelines in `CONTRIBUTING.md` ("If your pull request includes a user-visible change, add an appropriate entry under the **Unreleased** section of `CHANGELOG.md`").

### Link audit (per issue checklist)

| Link | Status |
| --- | --- |
| `https://tollcraft.gitbook.io/docs` | 200 OK |
| `https://github.com/Tollcraft` | 200 OK |
| `https://github.com/Tollcraft/soroban-cost-linter` | 200 OK |
| `https://github.com/Tollcraft/soroban-budget-assert` | 200 OK |
| `https://github.com/trailofbits/dylint` | 200 OK |
| `https://discord.gg/5aprtMSyR` | 200 OK |
| `https://t.me/+Gflo5jZStw1jMjE0` | 200 OK |
| `https://github.com/mallison031` | 200 OK |
| `https://contrib.rocks/image?repo=Tollcraft/soroban-cost-linter` | 200 OK |
| `https://asciinema.org/a/1DpqHMqqOOXoZzMI` | could not probe from sandbox (asciinema egress timed out); preexisting |
| `docs/integration.md#editor--ide-integration` | anchor matches `## Editor / IDE Integration` |
| `docs/integration.md#github-actions` | anchor matches `## GitHub Actions` |
| `docs/lints/soroban_storage_in_loop.md` | file exists |
| `docs/lints/redundant_env_clone.md` | file exists |
| `docs/lints/unnecessary_host_function_call.md` | file exists |
| `docs/lints/bytes_append_in_loop.md` (newly linked) | file exists |
| `docs/lints/symbol_new_for_short_literal.md` (newly linked) | file exists |
| `CONTRIBUTING.md` | file exists |

### Quality checks

- `cargo fmt --all -- --check` — passes
- `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` — passes
- `cargo test --workspace` — pre-existing UI smoke test (`test_json_output` in `cargo-cost-lint/tests/integration.rs`) fails inside this sandbox because the `dylint-link` helper binary cannot be executed (Permission denied, os error 13). This is an environment limitation of the sandbox, not a code regression. The same test passes in the project's GitHub Actions CI; please re-run locally to confirm.

### Notes

- The `src/module_34.rs` "key file" mentioned in the original task template appears to be an issue-template red herring — the repo does not have a top-level `src/` and the task is docs-only. Ignored.
- The lint count (5) intentionally matches `docs/lints/README.md`, which is the public, on-disk reference. `soroban_cost_lints/src/lib.rs` registers a sixth lint (`HOST_IN_LOOP`) that is not yet documented in `docs/lints/` and is therefore intentionally omitted from this PR. Tracking that lint is out of scope for #190.

Closes #190

docs: update outdated README links and align lint list with docs (#190)

The README Features section listed only the original three lints and linked
exclusively to those doc pages, even though `docs/lints/` already documents
five shipped lints and `soroban_cost_lints/src/lib.rs` registers them all.
Result: two lint doc pages (`bytes_append_in_loop.md`,
`symbol_new_for_short_literal.md`) were not linked from the README, and the
hardcoded "Three lints ship in v0.1.1" line contradicted the current state
of `main`.

Changes:
- README.md Features: list all five lints with their docs/lints/*.md links
  and clearly mark which ship in the released v0.1.1 vs. remain Unreleased,
  so users installing v0.1.1 are not misled into expecting five lints.
- CHANGELOG.md: add a missing Unreleased entry for `bytes_append_in_loop`,
  which had previously been credited only in source code and docs.

Closes #190

Hi @chiprime 👋

This PR currently has **merge conflicts with `main`** and can't be merged as-is. Please resolve them so we can move forward with the review.

```bash
git remote add upstream https://github.com/Tollcraft/soroban-cost-linter.git   # if not already added
git fetch upstream
git checkout <your-branch>
git rebase upstream/main      # or: git merge upstream/main
# resolve the conflicted files, then:
git add .
git rebase --continue         # or: git commit  (if you merged)
git push --force-with-lease    # plain 'git push' if you merged instead of rebased
```

A couple of reminders while you're at it:
- Make sure the branch still builds and `cargo test` passes after the rebase.
- Commit messages must follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) — CI enforces this.

Ping us here once it's updated and we'll re-review. Thanks for contributing! 🙏
